actors.name: Employee
actors.private_context: Employee is being considered for a promotion. They have been performing well and hope to be promoted before the end of the quarter. They have no direct control over the decision.

actors.name: Manager
actors.private_context: Manager is responsible for recommending the employee for promotion. They have the authority to initiate the promotion process. They are aware of the employee's performance and the upcoming quarterly review.

actors.name: HR
actors.private_context: HR handles the formal approval and processing of promotions. They require a recommendation from the manager and may have additional criteria or timelines.

shared_context: The company has a standard promotion process that requires a manager's recommendation and HR approval. The end of the quarter is 2026-09-30. The employee is eligible for promotion.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. No promotion decision has been made yet.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the promotion was formally approved and communicated to the employee before 2026-09-30T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
